dedupe_keys.name: southern cone food and physical activity built environment data

description: This Mendeley deposit records observed food-retail and physical-activity features of neighbourhoods in four Southern Cone cities: Marcos Paz, Bariloche, Temuco and Canelones-Barros Blancos. The Scientific Data descriptor describes standardised street, open-space and food-store observation forms with a dictionary and protocol. A modeller can use the attributes to represent local walking conditions or food-access opportunities in urban service and active-mobility simulations. The observations sample selected neighbourhoods and do not establish every resident's behaviour, access or health outcome. Differences among cities and observation instruments need checking before pooling. The own Mendeley page names the release and DataCite states CC BY 4.0. I read repository and article metadata without downloading forms or individual records; the public HTML did not list files. Related retail purchase data from London are geographically distinct, not duplicates. No exact catalogue record was found.
